card.name: Resuming schedule after a skipped dose
card.fires_on: Words right after the instruction to skip a missed dose, where the text turns to the next dose being taken or given at the regular time. It marks the verb (taken, take, given), the word dose, or the joining word and.

modes.label: Verb for the next dose
modes.description: The verb taken, take or given in the clause about the next scheduled dose.
modes.example: the next dose should be<< taken>> at the usual time.

modes.label: Linking word after skip
modes.description: The word and or dose that joins the skipped-dose instruction to the next-dose instruction.
modes.example: If a dose is missed by more than 12 hours, skip the missed dose<< and>> take the next dose at the scheduled time

card.plain: It fires in missed-dose directions at the point where the label says to skip the dose and go back to the normal schedule.
evidence: the next dose should be<< taken>> at its regularly scheduled time.
do not make up the dose and<< take>> the next dose as scheduled.
skip the missed dose and administer the next<< dose>> at the regularly scheduled time.
